targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS requests FROM requests
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS requests FROM requests

panels.title: Mean cost / request (USD)
panels.description: Paid-tier list-price estimate from config/prices.yaml. Actual spend on the Gemini API free tier is $0.

targets.queryText: SELECT AVG(total_cost_usd) AS cost FROM requests WHERE errors = '[]'
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT AVG(total_cost_usd) AS cost FROM requests WHERE errors = '[]'

targets.queryText: SELECT AVG(decode_tps) AS tps FROM llm_calls WHERE call_type = 'llm' AND decode_tps IS NOT NULL
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT AVG(decode_tps) AS tps FROM llm_calls WHERE call_type = 'llm' AND decode_tps IS NOT NULL

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS retried FROM llm_calls WHERE attempts > 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS retried FROM llm_calls WHERE attempts > 1

panels.title: Cost per request over time (USD)
panels.description: Paid-tier list-price estimate from config/prices.yaml. Actual spend on the Gemini API free tier is $0.

targets.queryText: SELECT finished_at AS time, total_cost_usd AS cost_usd FROM requests WHERE errors = '[]' ORDER BY finished_at
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT finished_at AS time, total_cost_usd AS cost_usd FROM requests WHERE errors = '[]' ORDER BY finished_at

targets.queryText: SELECT started_at AS time, decode_tps FROM llm_calls WHERE call_type = 'llm' AND decode_tps IS NOT NULL ORDER BY started_at
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT started_at AS time, decode_tps FROM llm_calls WHERE call_type = 'llm' AND decode_tps IS NOT NULL ORDER BY started_at

targets.queryText: SELECT strategy, COUNT(*) AS requests, AVG(total_cost_usd) AS mean_cost_usd, AVG(total_latency_ms) AS mean_latency_ms, AVG(total_latency_ms - backoff_ms) AS mean_latency_excl_backoff_ms, AVG(n_llm_calls) AS mean_llm_calls, AVG(input_tokens) AS mean_input_tokens FROM requests WHERE errors = '[]' GROUP BY strategy ORDER BY strategy
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strategy, COUNT(*) AS requests, AVG(total_cost_usd) AS mean_cost_usd, AVG(total_latency_ms) AS mean_latency_ms, AVG(total_latency_ms - backoff_ms) AS mean_latency_excl_backoff_ms, AVG(n_llm_calls) AS mean_llm_calls, AVG(input_tokens) AS mean_input_tokens FROM requests WHERE errors = '[]' GROUP BY strategy ORDER BY strategy

targets.queryText: SELECT node, COUNT(*) AS calls, AVG(decode_tps) AS mean_decode_tps, AVG(ttft_ms) AS mean_ttft_ms, AVG(latency_ms) AS mean_latency_ms, AVG(input_tokens) AS mean_input_tokens, AVG(output_tokens) AS mean_output_tokens, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost_usd FROM llm_calls WHERE call_type IN ('llm', 'judge') GROUP BY node ORDER BY node
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT node, COUNT(*) AS calls, AVG(decode_tps) AS mean_decode_tps, AVG(ttft_ms) AS mean_ttft_ms, AVG(latency_ms) AS mean_latency_ms, AVG(input_tokens) AS mean_input_tokens, AVG(output_tokens) AS mean_output_tokens, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost_usd FROM llm_calls WHERE call_type IN ('llm', 'judge') GROUP BY node ORDER BY node
